claims.statement: Tom Allen beat Tompkin Gilbert in a glove fight for the English championship; Gilbert left the ring after the seventh round and Allen was declared the winner, after 16 minutes 45 seconds.

fights.notes: Round-by-round account from the London Sporting Life of Oct 31. Allen claimed a foul, which the referee disallowed. Same fight as 600.

notes: The round times are listed in the text; only the total duration and the result are recorded.
